basics.name: Sumit Jha
basics.label: Full Stack Software Developer
basics.summary: Full-stack engineer with expertise in AI-powered applications, medical imaging, and real-time graphics. Builds scalable Python/FastAPI backends, React frontends, and WebGL visualization systems with production deployment experience.

work.name: Python AI Solutions Ltd.
work.summary: Delivered diverse full-stack solutions spanning AI-powered medical imaging, enterprise scheduling systems, and advanced UI component libraries. Built a medical imaging platform integrating SOTA deep learning models with interactive viewers, architected a production-ready Flask scheduler with enterprise LDAP authentication and comprehensive CI/CD, and developed unified imaging UI demos with WebGL2 components for Niivue. Expertise spans FastAPI/Flask backends, real-time rendering systems, enterprise authentication, and deployment with Docker/Kubernetes.

projects.name: Clinical Histological screening interface
projects.description: Developed an end-to-end AI-powered Clinical Histological screening platform with real-time classification and interactive medical image visualization.
highlights: Built a full-stack medical imaging application integrating SOTA deep learning models with 92%+ confidence scoring
Engineered an interactive web-based viewer using Niivue library with real-time overlay rendering, ROI navigation, and drag-and-drop functionality for cytology slide analysis
Developed FastAPI REST API with CUDA optimization for real-time image inference, supporting multiple input formats (base64, URLs, file uploads) and fallback mechanisms
Delivered deployment with Docker containerization and Kubernetes manifests, enabling scalable medical AI workflows for clinical environments

projects.name: Niivue
projects.description: Delivered a unified imaging UI demo and component library integrated into Niivue; simplified rendering, improved reliability/UX, and set direction for a consolidated HUD overlay.
highlights: Built the @niivue/niivue-uikit demo package showcasing WebGL2 UIKit controls wired to Niivue in real time (brightness/contrast, opacity, zoom, slice navigation; crosshair/colorbar/radiological toggles; colormap and view‑mode selectors).

Implemented a single‑canvas HUD overlay prototype to replace multiple layers, reducing overdraw and state changes, fixing component overlap, and aligning UI to the brain view; made the kit configurable and reusable across web and desktop.

Enhanced rendering and text systems: added text, ruler, and rectangle drawing; fixed UIKFont measurement and default font loading; eliminated white artifacts with transparent font textures; shader polish (e.g., circle GLSL).
Streamlined developer workflow with TypeScript configs and a dev:uikit script for rapid demo access; aligned design with maintainers to support reserving a UI panel region alongside image tiles.

projects.name: FMRIF Scheduler
projects.description: Architected a production-ready Flask scheduling application with enterprise authentication, containerized CI/CD, and comprehensive testing infrastructure.
highlights: Built enterprise LDAP authentication with NIH Active Directory integration, supporting email/username login, account status validation, connection pooling, and secure token-based sessions
Reworked configuration management using Pydantic-settings with nested classes, type validation, and dual .env/environment variable support with automatic discovery
Implemented comprehensive CI/CD pipeline with GitHub Actions, dual-stack testing (Python pytest + Playwright), browser caching, containerized environments, and coverage reporting
Containerized application stack with Docker Compose orchestrating PostgreSQL, LDAP, and Flask services; automated database initialization and multi-environment deployment
Enhanced developer workflow with pre-commit hooks (Ruff, Prettier, ESLint), automated setup scripts, and streamlined onboarding process
